## Bounce It! (Rootless)

**Bouncy animations, from Jake James's Bounce It!** Opening and closing apps and folders, and swiping home, overshoot a little and settle with a bounce.

- The same feel as the original 1.0.4, rebuilt for today's iOS.
- No settings. To turn it off, uninstall it.
- **The App Switcher stays steady:** its cards no longer bounce and wander while you swipe through them or close apps. Opening and closing apps and the home swipe still bounce.

- **iOS 15 to 27.** Rootless and RootHide jailbreaks.
- Tested on an iPhone 11 Pro Max (iOS 16.2) and an iPhone SE 2nd gen (iOS 17.5.1).
- If it ever sends your phone to Safe Mode, open Sileo (it still works there) and uninstall it. Then [tell me](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).

- It replaces the original Bounce It!. The two can't be installed together.
- The App Switcher and Reachability don't bounce: newer iOS moved those animations.
**Bounce It!** by **Jake James** (jakeashacks), originally for iOS 11 to 13. Rootless and RootHide port by **Jond-ie**.
